5e6c3e.evidence: Vitest PoC (tests/unit/auth-forgery.poc.test.ts, 4/4 passing) against real auth.ts with mocked prisma: default-secret JWT forgery (vuln-0001), userPoolId-keyed internal token forgery (vuln-0003), ?token= acceptance (vuln-0005). Role escalation via claim: confirmed membership lookup falls back to token claims when no membership row exists (auth.ts:230-236) — real primitive included in vuln-0001.

6b9e1f.risk_area: API-key auth (hash matching, expiry, scope check)
6b9e1f.evidence: SHA-256 hash lookup on api_keys with is_active and expiry checks plus widget:connect scope check before any org-scoped data access (widget-auth.service.ts:24-58; widget.routes.ts:29-37). No timing-safe compare (hash lookup) but SHA-256 preimage resistance makes that inert. No query-param auth on widget routes.

1566bc.surface: backend/src/config/index.ts (JWT_SECRET default, auth mode, secret validation)
1566bc.risk_area: hardcoded default credentials / missing startup guard
1566bc.evidence: config/index.ts:30 defaults JWT_SECRET to public literal with no refine/guard anywhere (checked src/config/index.ts, src/app.ts, src/index.ts). Filed as root cause of vuln-0001.

0748b9.evidence: GET /api/auth/config discloses userPoolId (secret for internal-token HMAC in cognito mode — vuln-0003). POST /api/auth/register is public and state-changing by design (self-registration, member role in default org; owner only when memberCount==0 — a race could mint a second owner but no auth bypass). /auth/me validates token but does not run the membership-migration path. Token-in-URL covered in vuln-0005.

fb8bfb.evidence: Guard authorizes path :id scope; mutation targets membershipId with no scope/org binding (validated-vs-consumed mismatch). vuln-0002; local vitest confirms middleware fail-open.

0f2e03.surface: backend/src/routes/index.ts route registration (public vs authenticated surfaces)
0f2e03.risk_area: unauthenticated mutation surface / missing auth on state-changing routes
0f2e03.evidence: Public registrations: /health, /api/auth, im webhook routes (/api/im, signature-verified), /api/v1/webhook/:id/trigger + /status (state-changing but by design, with IP allowlist/disabled checks in webhookService.triggerWebhook), widget routes (API-key preHandler), llm-proxy/a2a/openapi (API-key auth per code comments verified in route files). No route registered without an auth preHandler that mutates state without its own credential check.

7ecd27.risk_area: cross-org agent authorization via org-unbound agent_permissions
7ecd27.evidence: Permission lookup keyed only on (agent_id,user_id), no organization_id; validated by local vitest returning true cross-org. vuln-0004.

ac25bf.risk_area: account takeover via email-binding / ID-migration raw SQL
ac25bf.evidence: Migration path (rebinding profiles by email to a Cognito sub) only runs in cognito mode after aws-jwt-verify validates the id_token against the real pool (verifyToken -> CognitoJwtVerifier), so email claim is trusted from a signature-verified token. Raw SQL uses parameterized $executeRawUnsafe with placeholders (no injection). Tables missing are swallowed silently but that is a robustness issue, not auth.

066e91.risk_area: user-level ownership check on chat sessions (IDOR)
066e91.evidence: findById filters org only, no user_id; validated by local vitest. vuln-0006.

326cfd.risk_area: unauthenticated webhook reaching cross-org IM channel binding and agent chat
326cfd.evidence: Follow-up agent (IM/WebSocket auth validator) executed local PoC (tests/unit/im-webhook-auth.poc.test.ts, Fastify inject, mocked prisma/agent): unauthenticated POST returns 200 with agent-processed reply + session_id in victim org; 404-vs-200 enumeration oracle. Filed as vuln-0007.

history.evidence: findBindingById fetches binding by id with no auth or secret verification, then passes text into imService.handleMessage (src/routes/im.routes.ts:726-767). Validated statically only; did not execute the IM pipeline, so unverified whether attacker-controlled text reaches agent replies/credential vault.

fecd63.surface: documents/apiKeys/files/users/workflows route families + base.repository org scoping
fecd63.evidence: All reviewed routes pass request.user.orgId into services/repos; base.repository findById/update/delete filter on organization_id; file.service validateFileAccess enforces org prefix. Clean sweep (agentPermissions/im/chat/checkpoint exceptions reported separately).

898940.risk_area: Missing authentication/authorization on webhook → unauthenticated agent execution and session creation
898940.evidence: Executed vitest PoC (tests/unit/im-webhook-auth.poc.test.ts) against real route on Fastify inject(): unauthenticated POST returns 200 with agent-processed text and session_id; 404 oracle for unknown binding IDs. Full trace im.routes.ts:736 → findBindingById (prisma findUnique, no org check, no signature) → imService.handleMessage → chatService.processMessage as binding.created_by in victim org. Filed as vuln-0007.

c3bd3c.surface: GET /ws/executions WebSocket gateway (src/websocket/execution.gateway.ts, registered in src/app.ts:208)
c3bd3c.risk_area: Unauthenticated WebSocket subscribe to any org's/user's workflow execution events
c3bd3c.evidence: Static trace: gateway.register (execution.gateway.ts:125-142) registers fastify.get('/ws/executions', {websocket:true}, (socket) => this.handleConnection(socket)) with NO preHandler authenticate, no token check in the handler signature (request discarded as _request), and no org/user validation in handleSubscribe (~line 232) — any executionId string is accepted into the subscription map. No global auth hook exists in app.ts (only onResponse audit). broadcastToExecution delivers workflow events (node status, logs, output data) to all subscribers regardless of identity.

f7f290.evidence: All hits are PoC/docs/example credentials (app-hosting poc k8s + docker-compose creds, docker-compose postgres:postgres, .env.example placeholders) or node_modules fixtures. No production AWS keys or live secrets found.

b6f031.evidence: 402 CVEs total across manifests; triaged backend direct deps by import analysis. Filed: js-yaml CVE-2026-53550 (reachable, user YAML), nodemailer CVE-2026-82662 (reachable, SMTP), fastify CVE-2026-84504 (reachable, framework), ws CVE-2026-48779 (not_applicable, type-only import). fast-xml-parser/axios/protobufjs/mysql2/hono etc: no imports in backend/src (transitive/dev only).

ca154e.evidence: JWT_SECRET default 'super-agent-local-dev-secret-change-in-production' at config/index.ts:30 (already filed by another agent as vuln-0001, deduplicated). INSFORGE_JWT_SECRET default 'spike-test-secret-key-must-be-32-chars-long' at config/index.ts:145 used in apps.routes.ts:453 HMAC token minting — filed as vuln-0008.
